title.zh: 卷287 列傳七十四 佟国维 马齐 阿灵阿 揆叙 鄂伦岱
title.en: Volume 287 Biographies 74: Tong Guo Wei, Ma Qi, A Ling A, Kui Xu, E Lundai
title.raw: 卷287 列傳七十四 佟国维 马齐 阿灵阿 揆叙 鄂伦岱

sentences.zh: 列傳七十四

translations.literal: Biographies 74
translations.idiomatic: Biography 74

sentences.zh: 佟國維馬齊阿靈阿揆敘鄂倫岱

translations.literal: Tong Guowei, Ma Qi, Aringa, Kui Xu, and Olondai
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guowei · Ma Qi · Aringa · Kui Xu · Olondai

sentences.zh: 佟國維，滿洲鑲黃旗人，佟國賴次子，孝康章皇后幼弟，孝懿仁皇后父也。

translations.literal: Tong Guowei was a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, the second son of Tong Guolai, the younger brother of Empress Xiaokangzhang, and the father of Empress Xiaoyiren.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guowei, of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, was Tong Guolai's second son, the Empress Xiaokangzhang's younger brother, and the father of Empress Xiaoyiren.

sentences.zh: 順治間，授一等侍衛。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign he was appointed a first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shunzhi era he was made a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi he was appointed a Grand Minister of the Interior.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 9 he was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂反，子應熊以額駙居京師，謀為亂，以紅帽為號。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui rebelled, his son Yingxiong, as an imperial son-in-law residing in the capital, plotted rebellion and took the red cap as their signal.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui rose in rebellion, his son Yingxiong lived in the capital as an imperial son-in-law and plotted an uprising, using the red cap as their rallying sign.

sentences.zh: 國維發其事，命率侍衛三十人捕治，獲十馀人，械送刑部誅之。

translations.literal: Guowei exposed the affair; he was ordered to lead thirty bodyguards to arrest the conspirators, seized more than ten men, and sent them in fetters to the Ministry of Punishment for execution.
translations.idiomatic: Guowei reported the plot; the emperor ordered him to take thirty bodyguards, make the arrests, capture more than ten men, and send them in chains to the Ministry of Punishment for execution.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授領侍衛內大臣、議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard and a Deliberative Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 he was made Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard and a Deliberative Minister.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，推孝懿仁皇后恩，封一等公。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, in recognition of the grace of Empress Xiaoyiren, he was enfeoffed as a first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, on account of Empress Xiaoyiren's favor, he was enfeoffed as a first-class duke.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，師徵噶爾丹，命參贊大將軍裕親王軍務，次烏闌布通，與兄都統國綱並率左翼兵進戰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, when the army campaigned against Galdan, he was ordered to assist in the military affairs of the Grand General, the Prince of Yu, halted at Ulan Butong, and together with his elder brother, the Commandant Tong Guogang, jointly led the left-wing troops into battle.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29, during the campaign against Galdan, he was ordered to assist the Grand General, the Prince of Yu; the army halted at Ulan Butong, and he and his elder brother Commandant Tong Guogang together led the left wing into action.

sentences.zh: 國綱戰沒，國維自山腰出賊後擊之，潰遁。

translations.literal: Guogang fell in battle; Guowei came out from the mountainside behind the enemy and struck them, and they broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Guogang was killed in battle; Guowei attacked from the slope behind the enemy, and they routed and fled.

sentences.zh: 師還，以未窮追，部議當奪官，命罷議政大臣，鐫四級留任。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because the pursuit had not been pressed to the end, the ministry proposed that his office be stripped; he was ordered removed as Deliberative Minister and demoted four ranks while retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return, because the enemy had not been pursued to the finish, the ministry recommended stripping his rank; the emperor removed him as Deliberative Minister, cut four grades, and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，從上徵噶爾丹，出獨石口，以駝運稽遲請罪，上貰之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he followed the emperor on the campaign against Galdan, marching out by Dushikou; he pleaded guilty for delay in camel transport, and the emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 35 he followed the emperor against Galdan, leaving by Dushikou; he asked pardon for slow camel transport, and the emperor excused him.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，復從上徵噶爾丹，噶爾丹竄死。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he again followed the emperor against Galdan; Galdan fled and died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 he again followed the emperor against Galdan; Galdan fled and died.

sentences.zh: 敘功，還所鐫級。

translations.literal: When merit was recorded, the demoted grades were restored.
translations.idiomatic: When merits were tallied, his stripped grades were restored.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，以老解任。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he was released from office on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: In year 43 he retired on account of old age.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，皇太子允礽以病廢幽禁，上鬱怒成疾。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year the Crown Prince Yinreng was deposed and confined on grounds of illness; the emperor, deeply angered, fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In year 47 Crown Prince Yinreng was deposed and imprisoned for illness; the emperor, brooding in anger, fell sick.

sentences.zh: 國維奏：「皇上治事精明，斷無錯誤。

translations.literal: Guowei memorialized: 'Your Majesty's governance is exceedingly sharp and can in no way be mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: Guowei submitted: 'Your Majesty governs with such keen judgment that there can be no error.

sentences.zh: 此事於聖躬關係甚大，請度日後若易於措置，祈速賜睿斷；

translations.literal: This matter bears greatly upon Your Majesty's person; I beg that if it will later be easy to settle, Your Majesty will quickly bestow a sage decision;
translations.idiomatic: This affair touches Your Majesty's person most deeply. If it may later prove easy to settle, I beg Your Majesty to grant a swift, sage decision;

sentences.zh: 若難於措置，亦祈速賜睿斷。

translations.literal: and if it will be hard to settle, I also beg that Your Majesty will quickly bestow a sage decision.
translations.idiomatic: and if it will prove hard to settle, I likewise beg Your Majesty to grant a swift, sage decision.

sentences.zh: 總之，將原定意指熟慮施行為是。

translations.literal: In sum, it is best to deliberate carefully and carry out the purpose originally fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In any case, it is best to weigh carefully and execute the purpose Your Majesty originally fixed.

sentences.zh: 」上命諸大臣保奏諸皇子中孰可為皇太子者，諸大臣舉皇子允禩，上愈不懌。

translations.literal: ' The emperor ordered the great ministers to recommend which of the princes could be made crown prince; the ministers nominated Prince Yinshi, and the emperor grew still more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: ' The emperor ordered the great ministers to recommend which prince might be made crown prince; the ministers named Prince Yinshi, and the emperor grew still more displeased.

sentences.zh: 旋以皇太子病癒，命釋之。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, because the crown prince's illness had healed, he ordered him released.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, learning the crown prince's illness had healed, he ordered him released.

sentences.zh: 四十八年正月，召諸大臣詰孰先舉允禩，實出大學士馬齊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-eighth year he summoned the great ministers and demanded who had first nominated Yinshi; it turned out to be Grand Secretary Ma Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 48 he summoned the great ministers and asked who had first proposed Yinshi; it proved to be Grand Secretary Ma Qi.

sentences.zh: 上召國維，舉國維前奏語，問：「爾既解任，事與爾無與。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Guowei, cited Guowei's earlier memorial, and asked: 'You have already left office — the affair does not concern you.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Guowei, quoted his earlier memorial, and asked: 'You have already retired — this matter does not concern you.

sentences.zh: 乃先眾陳奏，何意？

translations.literal: Yet you spoke before the others — what was your intent?'
translations.idiomatic: Yet you spoke ahead of everyone — what did you mean?'

sentences.zh: 」國維對：「臣雖解任，蒙皇上命為國舅，冀聖躬速愈，故請速定其事。

translations.literal: Guowei replied: 'Though I have left office, Your Majesty appointed me imperial uncle-in-law; hoping for Your Majesty's swift recovery, I therefore asked that the matter be settled quickly.'
translations.idiomatic: Guowei answered: 'Though I have left office, Your Majesty made me the emperor's uncle by marriage; wishing Your Majesty a swift recovery, I asked that the matter be settled at once.'

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「將來措置難易，至時自知之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Whether settlement will later prove easy or hard — when the time comes, one will know.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'Whether it will later be easy or hard to settle — you will know when the time comes.

sentences.zh: 人其可懷私而妄言乎？

translations.literal: Can a man cherish private aims and speak rashly?'
translations.idiomatic: Can anyone indulge private motives and speak recklessly?'

sentences.zh: 」次日，复諭曰：「爾每言祝天求佛，原皇上萬歲。

translations.literal: The next day he again instructed: 'You always say you pray to Heaven and beseech the Buddha that the emperor may live ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he again said: 'You always say you pray to Heaven and the Buddha that the emperor may live ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 嗣後惟深念朕躬，謂諸皇子皆吾君之子，不有所依附而陷害其馀，是即俾朕易於措置也。

translations.literal: Hereafter think only deeply of my person, and regard all the princes as sons of your lord; do not attach yourself to some and plot against the rest — that is what will make it easy for me to settle matters.'
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth think only of my person: all the princes are your lord's sons; do not take sides and plot against the others — that is how you will make matters easy for me to settle.'

sentences.zh: 」閱月，上已定復立允礽為皇太子，又諭曰：「爾乃國舅，又為大臣。

translations.literal: A month later the emperor had already decided to restore Yinreng as crown prince, and again instructed: 'You are the emperor's uncle and also a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: A month later the emperor had already resolved to restore Yinreng as crown prince and said again: 'You are the emperor's uncle and also a great minister.

sentences.zh: 皇太子前染瘋疾，朕為國家計，安可不行拘執？

translations.literal: When the crown prince earlier suffered madness, how could I, for the state's sake, not have him confined?
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince earlier fell mad, could I, for the state's sake, have failed to confine him?

sentences.zh: 後知為人鎮魘，調治全癒，又安可不行釋放？

translations.literal: Later, learning he had been harmed by sorcery and was fully cured, how could I not have released him?
translations.idiomatic: Later, learning he had been struck down by witchcraft and was wholly cured, how could I not have released him?

sentences.zh: 朕拘執皇太子時，並無他意。

translations.literal: When I confined the crown prince I had no other purpose.
translations.idiomatic: When I confined the crown prince I had no other design.

sentences.zh: 不知爾肆出大言，激烈陳奏，果何心也？

translations.literal: I do not know why you uttered such violent words in fierce memorial — what was truly in your heart?
translations.idiomatic: I do not know why you spoke so wildly and memorialized so fiercely — what was truly in your heart?

sentences.zh: 諸大臣聞爾言，眾皆恐懼，遂欲立允禩為皇太子，列名保奏。

translations.literal: Hearing your words, the great ministers were all afraid and then wished to make Yinshi crown prince, listing their names in a joint recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: When the great ministers heard you, they were all terrified and then wished to make Yinshi crown prince, signing a joint recommendation.

sentences.zh: 朕臨御已久，安享太平，並無所謂難措置者，臣庶亦各安逸得所。

translations.literal: I have long ruled and enjoy peace; there is nothing that can be called hard to settle, and my subjects likewise rest secure each in his place.
translations.idiomatic: I have reigned long in peace; nothing is truly hard to settle, and my subjects each rest secure.

sentences.zh: 今因爾言，群小复肆為妄語，​​諸臣俱終日憂慮，若無生路。

translations.literal: Now, because of your words, petty men again spread reckless talk; the ministers spend the whole day in anxiety as though they had no way to live.
translations.idiomatic: Now, because of what you said, petty men again spread reckless talk; the ministers spend whole days in dread as if they had no way to live.

sentences.zh: 此事關係甚重，爾既有此奏，必有確見，其何以令朕及皇太子、諸皇子不致殷憂，眾心亦可定？

translations.literal: This matter is of the utmost weight; since you made this memorial you must have a clear view — how can you keep me, the crown prince, and the princes from deep grief and also settle the hearts of all?
translations.idiomatic: This affair weighs most heavily; since you memorialized, you must have a clear view — how will you keep me, the crown prince, and the princes from deep grief and also settle every heart?

sentences.zh: 其明白陳奏。

translations.literal: State it plainly in a memorial.'
translations.idiomatic: Explain it plainly in a memorial.'

sentences.zh: 」國維引罪請誅戮。

translations.literal: Guowei acknowledged guilt and asked to be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Guowei confessed guilt and asked to be executed.

sentences.zh: 上复諭曰：「朕特為安撫群臣，非欲有所誅戮。

translations.literal: The emperor again instructed: 'I mean only to reassure the ministers, not to execute anyone.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again said: 'I mean only to reassure the ministers, not to put anyone to death.

sentences.zh: 爾初陳奏，眾方贊爾，謂如此方可謂國家大臣。

translations.literal: When you first memorialized, everyone praised you, saying only thus could one be called a great minister of the state.
translations.idiomatic: When you first memorialized, everyone praised you, saying only thus could one be called a true minister of the state.

sentences.zh: 今爾情狀畢露，人將謂爾為何如人？

translations.literal: Now your true disposition is fully exposed — what will people say you are?
translations.idiomatic: Now your true disposition is fully exposed — what will people say you are?

sentences.zh: 朕斷不加爾誅戮，爾其無懼，但不可卸責於朕。

translations.literal: I will certainly not put you to death; do not fear — but you may not shift the blame onto me.
translations.idiomatic: I will certainly not execute you; do not fear — but you may not shift blame onto me.

sentences.zh: 觀爾言迷妄，其亦為人鎮魘歟？

translations.literal: Seeing how deluded your words are, have you too been struck by sorcery?'
translations.idiomatic: Seeing how deluded your words are, have you too been bewitched?'

sentences.zh: 五十八年，卒，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he died; funeral sacrifices were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 58 he died; imperial funeral rites were granted.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，贈太傅，諡端純。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was posthumously made Grand Tutor, with the posthumous title Duanchun.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 1 he was posthumously made Grand Tutor with the posthumous title Duanchun.

sentences.zh: 世宗手書「仁孝勤恪」榜，命表於墓道。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor personally wrote the tablet 'Benevolent, filial, diligent, and earnest' and ordered it displayed at the tomb road.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong personally wrote the tablet 'Benevolent, Filial, Diligent, and Earnest' and ordered it set up along the tomb road.

sentences.zh: 子隆科多，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Longkedo has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Longkedo has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 馬齊，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，米斯翰子。

translations.literal: Ma Qi, of the Fuca clan, was a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and the son of Misihan.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi, of the Fuca clan and the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, was Misihan's son.

sentences.zh: 由廕生授工部員外郎。

translations.literal: Through yinsheng appointment he was made an assistant department director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: By yinsheng privilege he was appointed an assistant department director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 歷郎中，遷內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He served as a bureau director and was promoted Reader in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through bureau director to Reader in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十四年，出為山西布政使，擢巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Kangxi he went out as Shanxi Provincial Administration Commissioner and was then promoted Provincial Governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 24 he went out as Shanxi Administration Commissioner and was soon promoted Provincial Governor.

sentences.zh: 馬齊入覲，上褒其居官勤慎，勉以始終如一。

translations.literal: When Ma Qi came to audience, the emperor praised his diligence and prudence in office and exhorted him to remain so to the end.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Qi came to audience, the emperor praised his diligence and care in office and urged him to remain so to the end.

sentences.zh: 久之，上命九卿舉督撫清廉如於成龍者，以馬齊及范成勳、姚締虞對。

translations.literal: After some time the emperor ordered the Nine Ministers to recommend governors as incorrupt as Yu Chenglong; Ma Qi, Fan Chengxun, and Yao Deyu were named.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor ordered the Nine Ministers to name governors as incorrupt as Yu Chenglong; Ma Qi, Fan Chengxun, and Yao Deyu were put forward.

sentences.zh: 尋命偕成龍、開音布往按湖廣巡撫張汧貪黷狀。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to join Yu Chenglong and Kaiyinbu in investigating the corruption of Huguang Governor Zhang Han.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to join Yu Chenglong and Kaiyinbu in investigating Huguang Governor Zhang Han's corruption.

sentences.zh: 初命侍郎色楞額往按上荊南道祖澤深，並令察汧，色楞額曲庇，不以實陳。

translations.literal: At first Vice Minister Selenge had been sent to investigate Shangjing Circuit Intendant Zu Zeshen and also to look into Zhang Han; Selenge shielded them and did not report the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Vice Minister Selenge had been sent to investigate Shangjing Circuit Intendant Zu Zeshen and also to examine Zhang Han; Selenge covered for them and did not report truthfully.

sentences.zh: 馬齊與成龍覆按，具得汧、澤深貪墨狀，並色楞額論罪如律。

translations.literal: Ma Qi and Yu Chenglong reinvestigated and fully established the graft of Zhang Han and Zu Zeshen, and Selenge was punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi and Yu Chenglong reinvestigated, fully established Zhang Han's and Zu Zeshen's corruption, and Selenge was punished by law.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，遷左都御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 he was promoted Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 時俄羅斯遣使請定界，詔遣大臣往議。

translations.literal: At that time Russia sent envoys to request a border settlement; an edict dispatched great ministers to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Russia sent envoys to fix the border; an edict sent great ministers to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 馬齊疏言：「俄羅斯侵據疆土，我師困之於雅克薩城，本可立時剿滅，皇上寬容，不忍加誅。

translations.literal: Ma Qi memorialized: 'Russia has seized our territory; our troops had them trapped at Albazin and could have wiped them out at once, but the emperor was lenient and would not destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi memorialized: 'Russia has encroached on our territory; our troops had them besieged at Albazin and could have destroyed them at once, but the emperor was merciful and would not exterminate them.

sentences.zh: 今悔罪求和，特遣大臣往議，垂之史冊，關係甚鉅。

translations.literal: Now, repenting and seeking peace, special envoys are sent to negotiate — this will be recorded in the histories and is a matter of the greatest weight.
translations.idiomatic: Now, repenting and suing for peace, special envoys are sent to negotiate — this will stand in the histories and is a matter of the greatest weight.

sentences.zh: 其檔案宜兼書漢字，使臣並參用漢員。

translations.literal: The archives ought to be written also in Chinese characters, and Han officials should take part alongside the envoys.'
translations.idiomatic: The archives ought to be written in Chinese as well, and Han officials should serve alongside the envoys.'

sentences.zh: 」詔如議行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that it be done as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered it done as proposed.

sentences.zh: 尋命偕尚書張玉書等勘閱河工。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to join Minister Zhang Yushu and others in inspecting river works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to join Minister Zhang Yushu and others in inspecting river works.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was listed among the Deliberative Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he was made a Deliberative Minister.

sentences.zh: 都御史與議政，自馬齊始。

translations.literal: A Censor-in-Chief serving as Deliberative Minister began with Ma Qi.
translations.idiomatic: A censor-in-chief serving as Deliberative Minister began with Ma Qi.

sentences.zh: 尋遷兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 時喀爾喀諸部避噶爾丹侵掠，舉族內鄉。

translations.literal: At that time the Khalkha tribes, fleeing Galdan's raids, moved their entire peoples inward.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Khalkha tribes, fleeing Galdan's raids, moved their whole peoples inward.

sentences.zh: 詔沿邊安插，命馬齊偕侍郎布圖等先期檄左右翼部長至上都河、額爾屯河兩界以待。

translations.literal: An edict ordered settlement along the frontier; Ma Qi was ordered to join Vice Minister Butu and others to go ahead and summon the chiefs of the left and right wings to wait on the Shangdu River and the Ergun River boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered frontier settlement; Ma Qi was sent with Vice Minister Butu and others ahead to summon the left- and right-wing chiefs to wait on the Shangdu and Ergun river boundaries.

sentences.zh: 上出塞，喀爾喀諸部朝行在，定諸王、貝子、公等爵秩牧地。

translations.literal: When the emperor went beyond the passes, the Khalkha tribes came to the traveling palace; ranks of princes, beile, and gong, and their pasture lands, were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went beyond the passes, the Khalkha tribes attended the traveling palace; ranks of princes, beile, and gong and their pasture lands were fixed.

sentences.zh: 烏珠穆沁台吉車根等叛附噶爾丹，命馬齊往按，寘諸法。

translations.literal: Chegen and other taiji of Ujimqin rebelled and joined Galdan; Ma Qi was sent to investigate and they were punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Chegen and other taiji of Ujimqin rebelled and joined Galdan; Ma Qi was sent to investigate and they were punished by law.

sentences.zh: 調戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，命馬齊檄喀喇沁、翁牛特兵備戰。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, when the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan, Ma Qi was ordered to rally the Kharchin and Onnigud troops for battle.
translations.idiomatic: In year 35, when the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan, Ma Qi was ordered to rally Kharchin and Onnigud troops for battle.

sentences.zh: 還京師，兼理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he concurrently served as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital he concurrently served as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹旋敗遁，詔來春复親出塞，命先期往寧夏安置驛站。

translations.literal: Galdan soon was defeated and fled; an edict said the emperor would again go beyond the passes in spring and ordered Ma Qi to go ahead to Ningxia to set up relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan was soon defeated and fled; an edict said the emperor would again go beyond the passes in spring and ordered Ma Qi ahead to Ningxia to establish relay stations.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，授武英殿大學士，賜御書「永世翼戴」榜。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory and granted an imperial inscription tablet reading 'Forever Supporting with Wings.'
translations.idiomatic: In year 38 he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory and granted an imperial tablet reading 'Forever Supporting with Wings.'

sentences.zh: 四十七年冬，皇太子允礽既廢，儲位未定，佟國維奏請速斷。

translations.literal: In the winter of the forty-seventh year, after Crown Prince Yinreng had been deposed and the heirship was unsettled, Tong Guowei memorialized asking for a swift decision.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year 47, after Crown Prince Yinreng had been deposed and the succession unsettled, Tong Guowei memorialized for a swift decision.

sentences.zh: 上召滿、漢文武諸大臣集暢春園議諸皇子中孰可為皇太子者。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Manchu and Han civil and military great ministers to assemble at the Garden of Everlasting Spring to discuss which prince could be made crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Manchu and Han civil and military great ministers to the Garden of Everlasting Spring to discuss which prince might be made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 上意在復立皇太子，而諸皇子中貝勒允禩覬為皇太子最力，諸大臣揆敘、王鴻緒及佟國綱子鄂倫岱等為之羽翼。

translations.literal: The emperor's mind was on restoring the crown prince, but among the princes Beile Yinshi coveted the crown prince's place most fiercely; great ministers Kui Xu and Wang Hongxu, together with Olondai, son of Tong Guogang, supported him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor intended to restore the crown prince, but among the princes Beile Yinshi coveted the position most fiercely; Grand Ministers Kui Xu and Wang Hongxu, with Olondai son of Tong Guogang, backed him.

sentences.zh: 集議日，馬齊先至，張玉書後入，問：「眾意誰屬？

translations.literal: On the day of deliberation Ma Qi arrived first; when Zhang Yushu entered later he asked: 'Whom does the multitude favor?'
translations.idiomatic: On the day of deliberation Ma Qi arrived first; when Zhang Yushu entered later he asked, 'Whom does the assembly favor?'

sentences.zh: 」馬齊言眾有欲舉八阿哥者。

translations.literal: Ma Qi said many wished to nominate the Eighth Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi said many wished to nominate the Eighth Prince.

sentences.zh: 俄，上命馬齊毋預議，馬齊避去。

translations.literal: Shortly the emperor ordered Ma Qi not to take part in the deliberation, and Ma Qi withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the emperor ordered Ma Qi not to join the deliberation, and Ma Qi withdrew.

sentences.zh: 阿靈阿等書「八」字密示諸大臣，諸大臣遂以允禩名上，上不懌。

translations.literal: Aringa and others secretly showed the character 'eight' to the great ministers, and the great ministers then submitted Yinshi's name; the emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Aringa and others secretly showed the character 'eight' to the great ministers, and they then submitted Yinshi's name; the emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，召諸大臣問其日先舉允禩者為誰，群臣莫敢對。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year he summoned the great ministers and asked who had first nominated Yinshi that day; none of the ministers dared answer.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year he summoned the great ministers and asked who had first proposed Yinshi that day; none dared answer.

sentences.zh: 上嚴詰，群指都統巴琿岱。

translations.literal: Under stern questioning the assembly pointed to Commandant Ba Huundai.
translations.idiomatic: Under stern questioning the assembly pointed to Commandant Ba Huundai.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「是必佟國維、馬齊意也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'This must have been Tong Guowei's and Ma Qi's intent.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'This must have been Tong Guowei's and Ma Qi's doing.'

sentences.zh: 」馬齊奏辯。

translations.literal: Ma Qi memorialized in his own defense.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi memorialized in defense.

sentences.zh: 巴琿岱言漢大臣先舉。

translations.literal: Ba Huundai said the Han great ministers had nominated first.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Huundai said the Han great ministers had spoken first.

sentences.zh: 上以問大學士張玉書，玉書乃直舉馬齊語以對。

translations.literal: The emperor questioned Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu, and Yushu frankly reported Ma Qi's words in reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor questioned Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu, and Yushu frankly repeated Ma Qi's words.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「馬齊素謬亂。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Ma Qi has always been wildly mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'Ma Qi has always been wildly mistaken.

sentences.zh: 如此大事，尚懷私意，謀立允禩，豈非為異日恣肆專行計耶？

translations.literal: On so great a matter he still cherished private intent and plotted to make Yinshi crown prince — was this not planning to act arbitrarily and exclusively in days to come?'
translations.idiomatic: On so grave a matter he still cherished private intent and plotted to make Yinshi crown prince — was this not planning to act arbitrarily in days to come?'

sentences.zh: 」馬齊复力辯，辭窮，先出。

translations.literal: Ma Qi again argued strenuously; his words exhausted, he left first.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi argued again with all his strength; when his words failed, he left first.

sentences.zh: 翌日，上諭廷臣曰：「馬齊效用久，朕意欲保全之。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor instructed the court: 'Ma Qi has long served effectively; I wished to preserve him.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor told the court: 'Ma Qi has long served well; I meant to preserve him.

sentences.zh: 昨乃拂袖而出，人臣作威福如此，罪不可赦！

translations.literal: Yesterday he yet flung out his sleeve and left — for a subject to wield such authority is a crime that cannot be pardoned!'
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday he yet flung out his sleeve and left — for a subject to wield such power is unpardonable!'

sentences.zh: 」遂執馬齊及其弟馬武、李榮保下獄。

translations.literal: Ma Qi was thereupon arrested, together with his younger brother Ma Wu and Li Rongbao, and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi was thereupon arrested with his younger brother Ma Wu and Li Rongbao and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 王大臣議馬齊斬，馬武、李榮保坐罪有差，盡奪其族人官，上不忍誅，命以馬齊付允禩嚴錮，李榮保、馬武並奪官。

translations.literal: The princes and great ministers proposed that Ma Qi be beheaded and Ma Wu and Li Rongbao punished according to their degrees of guilt, stripping all their clansmen of office; the emperor could not bear to execute him and ordered Ma Qi handed to Yinshi for strict confinement, while Li Rongbao and Ma Wu were both stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and great ministers proposed Ma Qi be beheaded and Ma Wu and Li Rongbao punished to their degree, stripping all their clansmen of office; the emperor could not bear to kill him and ordered Ma Qi handed to Yinshi for strict confinement, while Li Rongbao and Ma Wu were both stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，俄羅斯來互市，上念馬齊習邊事，令董其事，李榮保、馬武皆復起。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year Russia came to trade at the border markets; the emperor, recalling Ma Qi's familiarity with frontier affairs, ordered him to oversee the matter; Li Rongbao and Ma Wu were both reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: In year 49 Russia came for border trade; remembering Ma Qi's knowledge of frontier affairs, the emperor put him in charge; Li Rongbao and Ma Wu were both restored.

sentences.zh: 尋命馬齊署內務府總管。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to act as Superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to serve as acting Superintendent of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，复授武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was again appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 55 he was again made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，降敕褒諭，予一等阿達哈哈番，尋命襲其祖哈什屯一等阿思哈尼哈番，進二等伯，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, he issued an edict of praise and reward, granting a first-class ada hafan; he was soon ordered to inherit his grandfather Hashutun's first-class ashan i hafan, was advanced to a second-class baron, and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he issued a commendatory edict, granting a first-class ada hafan; Ma Qi was soon ordered to inherit his grandfather Hashutun's first-class ashan i hafan, was raised to second-class baron, and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，改保和殿，進太保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was moved to the Hall of Preserving Harmony and advanced to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 1 he was moved to the Hall of Preserving Harmony and promoted Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 三年，复降詔褒其忠誠，加拜他喇布勒哈番，以其子富良襲。

translations.literal: In the third year an edict again praised his loyalty; he was granted an additional tabun niru hafan, which his son Fuliang inherited.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 another edict praised his loyalty; he was granted an additional tabun niru hafan, which his son Fuliang inherited.

sentences.zh: 十三年，引疾乞罷，許致仕。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, citing illness, he begged to retire and was permitted to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13, pleading illness, he asked to retire and was allowed to leave office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，病篤，高宗諭謂馬齊歷相三朝，年逾大耋，舉朝大臣未有及者，命和親王及皇長子視疾。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong, gravely ill, the Gaozong Emperor instructed that Ma Qi had served as chief minister through three reigns, was past great old age, and no minister in the whole court matched him; he ordered the Prince of He and the eldest imperial son to visit him in his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 4, gravely ill, Emperor Gaozong said Ma Qi had served as chief minister through three reigns, was past great old age, and no court minister matched him; he ordered the Prince of He and the eldest imperial son to visit him.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，年八十八，贈太傅，諡文穆。

translations.literal: He soon died at eighty-eight; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor with the posthumous title Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died at eighty-eight; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor with the posthumous title Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 子富興，襲爵，坐事黜，以富良襲，進一等伯。

translations.literal: His son Fuxing inherited the title but was dismissed for an offense; Fuliang inherited instead and was advanced to first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fuxing inherited the title but was dismissed for an offense; Fuliang inherited instead and was raised to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加封號曰敦惠。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year an additional style-name Dunhui was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 the additional style-name Dunhui was granted.

sentences.zh: 富良，自散秩大臣授鑾儀衛鑾儀使，累遷西安將軍，兼領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Fuliang, from Minister without Specific Duty, was appointed Director of the Imperial Procession Guard, rose to General of Xi'an, and concurrently served as Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Fuliang, from Minister without Specific Duty, was made Director of the Imperial Procession Guard, rose to General of Xi'an, and concurrently served as Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恭勤。

translations.literal: He died; his posthumous title was Gongqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died; his posthumous title was Gongqin.

sentences.zh: 馬武，馬齊弟。

translations.literal: Ma Wu was Ma Qi's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wu was Ma Qi's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 初授侍衛，兼管佐領。

translations.literal: He was first appointed a bodyguard and concurrently managed a company.
translations.idiomatic: He was first made a bodyguard and concurrently managed a company.

sentences.zh: 累擢鑲白旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Commandant of the Bordered White Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Vice Commandant of the Bordered White Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 因馬齊得罪奪官。

translations.literal: Because of Ma Qi's offense his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Qi fell from favor his office was stripped.

sentences.zh: 旋起內務府總管，遷鑲白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He was soon reinstated as Superintendent of the Imperial Household and transferred to Commandant of the Bordered White Banner Mongol Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored as Superintendent of the Imperial Household and transferred to Commandant of the Bordered White Banner Mongol Brigade.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, he was appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he was appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，卒，命視伯爵賜卹，授三等阿達哈哈番，賜祭葬，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng he died; he was ordered funeral rites according to a baron's rank, granted a third-class ada hafan, granted funeral sacrifices, with the posthumous title Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 4 he died; he was granted baronial funeral rites, a third-class ada hafan, imperial funeral sacrifices, and the posthumous title Qinke.

sentences.zh: 馬武子保祝，初授侍衛。

translations.literal: Ma Wu's son Baozhu was first appointed a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wu's son Baozhu was first made a bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷直隸提督，以病解任，起正紅旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He rose to Provincial Military Commissioner of Zhili, resigned on grounds of illness, and was then made Commandant of the Plain Red Banner Mongol Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Provincial Military Commissioner of Zhili, resigned for illness, and was then made Commandant of the Plain Red Banner Mongol Brigade.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恭簡。

translations.literal: He died; his posthumous title was Gongjian.
translations.idiomatic: He died; his posthumous title was Gongjian.

sentences.zh: 阿靈阿，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，遏必隆第五子。

translations.literal: Aringa, of the Niohuru clan, was a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and the fifth son of Ebilun.
translations.idiomatic: Aringa, of the Niohuru clan and the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, was Ebilun's fifth son.

sentences.zh: 初任侍衛，兼佐領。

translations.literal: He first served as a bodyguard and concurrently as company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as bodyguard and concurrent company commander.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十五年，襲一等公，授散秩大臣，擢鑲黃旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Kangxi he inherited a first-class duke, was appointed Minister without Specific Duty, and was promoted Commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 25 he inherited a first-class duke, was made Minister without Specific Duty, and was promoted Commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu Brigade.

sentences.zh: 阿靈阿女兄，上冊為貴妃。

translations.literal: Aringa's elder sister was enfeoffed by the emperor as Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Aringa's elder sister was enfeoffed by the emperor as Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 貴妃薨，殯朝陽門外，阿靈阿舉家在殯所持喪。

translations.literal: When the consort died she lay in state outside Chaoyang Gate; Aringa and his whole household kept mourning at the bier.
translations.idiomatic: When the consort died she lay in state outside Chaoyang Gate; Aringa and his whole household kept mourning at the bier.

sentences.zh: 與兄法喀素不睦，欲致之死，乃播蜚語誣法喀。

translations.literal: He was on bad terms with his elder brother Faka and wished to bring about his death, and so spread slander to frame Faka.
translations.idiomatic: He was estranged from his elder brother Faka and wished him dead, spreading slander to frame him.

sentences.zh: 法喀以聞上，震怒，奪阿靈阿職，仍留公爵。

translations.literal: Faka reported this to the emperor; enraged, the emperor stripped Aringa of office but retained his ducal title.
translations.idiomatic: Faka reported to the emperor; enraged, the emperor stripped Aringa's office but kept his dukedom.

sentences.zh: 尋授一等侍衛，累遷正藍旗蒙古都統，擢領侍衛內大臣、理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed a first-class bodyguard, rose to Commandant of the Plain Blue Banner Mongol Brigade, and was promoted Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard and Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made first-class bodyguard, rose to Commandant of the Plain Blue Banner Mongol Brigade, and was promoted Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard and Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，與揆敘、王鴻緒等密議舉允禩為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he joined Kui Xu, Wang Hongxu, and others in secret deliberation to nominate Yinshi as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In year 47 he joined Kui Xu, Wang Hongxu, and others in secretly plotting to make Yinshi crown prince.

sentences.zh: 上以馬齊示意諸大臣，予嚴譴，不復窮治興大獄。

translations.literal: The emperor, holding Ma Qi responsible for signaling the great ministers, gave a severe reprimand but did not pursue the matter to open a great persecution.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Ma Qi for signaling the ministers, gave a severe reprimand, but did not pursue a great purge.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 55 he died.

sentences.zh: 子阿爾松阿，降襲二等公，擢領侍衛內大臣、刑部尚書。

translations.literal: His son Ersong'a inherited at reduced rank as second-class duke and was promoted Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard and Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ersong'a inherited at reduced rank as second-class duke and was promoted Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard and Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，世宗召諸大臣諭曰：「本朝大臣中，居心奸險，結黨營私，惟阿靈阿、揆敘為甚。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng the Shizong Emperor summoned the great ministers and instructed: 'Among the great ministers of this dynasty, those most treacherous in heart and most given to faction and private gain are Aringa and Kui Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 2 Emperor Shizong summoned the great ministers and said: 'Among this dynasty's ministers, none were more treacherous in heart or more given to faction and private gain than Aringa and Kui Xu.

sentences.zh: 當年二阿哥之廢，斷自聖衷。

translations.literal: When the Second Prince was deposed in those years, the decision came solely from the Sacred Mind.
translations.idiomatic: When the Second Prince was deposed, the decision came solely from the Sacred Mind.

sentences.zh: 豈因臣下蜚語遂行廢立？

translations.literal: How could deposition and installation have followed mere slander from subjects?
translations.idiomatic: How could deposition and installation have followed mere slander from subjects?

sentences.zh: 乃阿靈阿、揆敘攘為己力，要結允禩等，造作無稽之言，轉相傳播，致皇考憤懣，莫可究詰。

translations.literal: Yet Aringa and Kui Xu claimed the deed as their own merit, courted Yinshi and others, fabricated baseless talk, and spread it from hand to hand, until my late father was filled with anger beyond all inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Aringa and Kui Xu claimed the deed as their own merit, courted Yinshi and others, fabricated baseless talk, and spread it hand to hand until my late father was filled with anger beyond all inquiry.

sentences.zh: 阿靈阿子阿爾松阿柔奸狡猾，甚於其父。

translations.literal: Aringa's son Ersong'a was soft, treacherous, and cunning — more so than his father.
translations.idiomatic: Aringa's son Ersong'a was soft, treacherous, and cunning — worse than his father.

sentences.zh: 令奪官，遣往奉天守其祖墓；

translations.literal: He was ordered stripped of office and sent to Fengtian to guard his grandfather's tomb;
translations.idiomatic: He was stripped of office and sent to Fengtian to guard his grandfather's tomb;

sentences.zh: 並將阿靈阿墓碑改鐫'不臣不弟暴悍貪庸阿靈阿之墓'，以正其罪。

translations.literal: and Aringa's tombstone was re-cut to read 'Tomb of Aringa — disloyal subject, unfilial brother, violent, greedy, and base,' to rectify his crime.
translations.idiomatic: and Aringa's tombstone was re-cut to read 'Tomb of Aringa — disloyal subject, unfilial brother, violent, greedy, and base,' to rectify his crime.

sentences.zh: 」四年，命誅阿爾松阿，妻子沒入官。

translations.literal: ' In the fourth year he ordered Ersong'a executed and his wife and children confiscated to the state.
translations.idiomatic: ' In year 4 he ordered Ersong'a executed and his wife and children confiscated.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，以阿靈阿墓碑立祖塋前，墓已遷而碑尚存，命去之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, because Aringa's tombstone still stood before the ancestral grave though the tomb had been moved, he ordered it removed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 1, because Aringa's tombstone still stood before the ancestral grave though the tomb had been moved, the emperor ordered it removed.

sentences.zh: 妻子釋令歸旗。

translations.literal: The wife and children were released and allowed to return to the banner.
translations.idiomatic: His wife and children were released and allowed to return to the banner.

sentences.zh: 揆敘，字凱功，納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人，大學士明珠子。

translations.literal: Kui Xu, style Kaigong, of the Nara clan, was a man of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and the son of Grand Secretary Mingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: Kui Xu, style Kaigong, of the Nara clan and the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, was Grand Secretary Mingzhu's son.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十五年，自二等侍衛授翰林院侍讀，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year of Kangxi, from second-class bodyguard he was appointed Hanlin Reader and served as Daily Lecturer on the Imperial Diary.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 35, from second-class bodyguard he was made Hanlin Reader and served as Daily Lecturer on the Imperial Diary.

sentences.zh: 累擢翰林院掌院學士，兼禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He rose to Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy and concurrently Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy and concurrent Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 奉使冊封朝鮮王妃。

translations.literal: He was sent on mission to invest the Queen of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent on mission to invest the Queen of Korea.

sentences.zh: 尋充經筵講官，教習庶吉士。

translations.literal: He soon served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium and instructor of junior compilers.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as Classics Colloquium lecturer and instructor of junior compilers.

sentences.zh: 遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 初，明珠柄政，勢焰薰灼。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Mingzhu held power, his influence blazed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Mingzhu held power, his influence blazed.

sentences.zh: 大治園亭，賓客滿門下。

translations.literal: He greatly built gardens and pavilions, and guests filled his gates.
translations.idiomatic: He greatly built gardens and pavilions, and guests filled his gates.

sentences.zh: 揆敘交遊既廣，尤工結納，素與允禩相結。

translations.literal: Kui Xu's connections were already wide, and he was especially skilled at forming ties; he had long been allied with Yinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Kui Xu's connections were already wide, and he was especially skilled at forming ties; he had long been allied with Yinshi.

sentences.zh: 皇太子既廢，揆敘與阿靈阿等播蜚語，言皇太子諸失德狀，杜其復立。

translations.literal: After the crown prince was deposed, Kui Xu and Aringa spread slander, speaking of the crown prince's various moral failings to block his restoration.
translations.idiomatic: After the crown prince was deposed, Kui Xu and Aringa spread slander, recounting the crown prince's moral failings to block his restoration.

sentences.zh: 四十七年冬，上召滿、漢大臣問諸皇子中孰可為皇太子者，揆敘及阿靈阿、鄂倫岱、王鴻緒等私與諸大臣通消息，諸大臣遂舉允禩。

translations.literal: In the winter of the forty-seventh year, when the emperor summoned Manchu and Han great ministers to ask which prince could be made crown prince, Kui Xu together with Aringa, Olondai, Wang Hongxu, and others privately exchanged messages with the great ministers, and the great ministers then nominated Yinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year 47, when the emperor summoned Manchu and Han ministers to ask which prince might be crown prince, Kui Xu with Aringa, Olondai, Wang Hongxu, and others privately signaled the ministers, who then nominated Yinshi.

sentences.zh: 事具馬齊傳。

translations.literal: The affair is given in full in Ma Qi's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is given in full in Ma Qi's biography.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，遷左都御史，仍掌翰林院事。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief while still directing Hanlin Academy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 51 he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief while still directing Hanlin affairs.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「近聞外省塘報，故摭拾大小事件，名曰'小報'，駭人耳目。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'Recently one hears that in the outer provinces, relay reports are picked up and assorted into great and small events under the name "little gazettes," startling people's ears and eyes.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: 'Recently in the outer provinces, relay reports are picked over and assorted into great and small events under the name "little gazettes," startling ears and eyes.

sentences.zh: 請飭嚴禁，庶好事不端之人，知所儆懼。

translations.literal: I beg that strict prohibition be ordered, so that ill-disposed men who delight in mischief may know fear.'
translations.idiomatic: I beg strict prohibition, so ill-disposed men who delight in mischief may know fear.'

sentences.zh: 」詔允行。

translations.literal: ' An edict approved and carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict approved and carried it out.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，卒，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he died; his posthumous title was Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56 he died; his posthumous title was Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，發揆敘及阿靈阿罪狀，追奪揆敘官，削諡。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng the crimes of Kui Xu and Aringa were published; Kui Xu's office was posthumously stripped and his posthumous title erased.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 2 the crimes of Kui Xu and Aringa were published; Kui Xu's office was posthumously stripped and his posthumous title erased.

sentences.zh: 墓碑改鐫「不忠不孝陰險柔佞揆敘之墓」。

translations.literal: His tombstone was re-cut to read 'Tomb of Kui Xu — disloyal, unfilial, insidious, and fawning.'
translations.idiomatic: His tombstone was re-cut to read 'Tomb of Kui Xu — disloyal, unfilial, insidious, and fawning.'

sentences.zh: 鄂倫岱，滿洲鑲黃旗人，佟國綱長子。

translations.literal: Olondai was a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and the eldest son of Tong Guogang.
translations.idiomatic: Olondai, of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, was Tong Guogang's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 初任一等侍衛。

translations.literal: He first served as a first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 出為廣州駐防副都統。

translations.literal: He went out as Deputy Commandant of the Guangzhou Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Deputy Commandant of the Guangzhou Garrison.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十九年，擢鑲黃旗漢軍都統，襲一等公。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Kangxi he was promoted Commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Brigade and inherited a first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 29 he was promoted Commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Brigade and inherited a first-class duke.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，鄂倫岱領漢軍兩旗火器營，出古北口。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, when the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan, Olondai led the firearms battalion of the two Chinese banners of the Han Brigade and marched out by Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 35, when the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan, Olondai led the firearms battalion of the two Han Brigade Chinese banners and marched out by Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 扈蹕北巡塞外。

translations.literal: He attended the emperor on the northern tour beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: He attended the emperor on the northern tour beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，擢領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was promoted Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 he was promoted Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 坐事降一等侍衛。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he was demoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed Minister without Specific Duty.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Minister without Specific Duty.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，复授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he was again appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 46 he was again appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，命出邊管蒙古驛站。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he was ordered beyond the frontier to manage Mongol relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: In year 59 he was ordered beyond the frontier to manage Mongol relay stations.

sentences.zh: 世宗立，召還，授正藍旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor took the throne he was recalled and appointed Commandant of the Plain Blue Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong took the throne he was recalled and appointed Commandant of the Plain Blue Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，諭曰：「鄂倫岱與阿靈阿皆黨於允禩。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng he instructed: 'Olondai and Aringa both belonged to Yinshi's faction.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 3 he instructed: 'Olondai and Aringa both belonged to Yinshi's faction.

sentences.zh: 當日允禩得罪，皇考時方駐蹕遙亭，命執允禩門下宦者刑訊，具言鄂倫岱等黨附狀。

translations.literal: When Yinshi offended in those days, my late father was then encamped at Yaoting and ordered Yinshi's household eunuchs taken and interrogated under torture; they fully reported how Olondai and others had attached themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yinshi offended then, my late father was encamped at Yaoting and ordered Yinshi's household eunuchs tortured for interrogation; they fully reported Olondai and others' factional attachment.

sentences.zh: 鄂倫岱等色變，不敢置辯。

translations.literal: Olondai and the others changed color and dared not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Olondai and the others turned pale and dared not reply.

sentences.zh: 四十九年春，皇考自霸州回鑾，途中責鄂倫岱等結黨，鄂倫岱悍然不顧。

translations.literal: In the spring of the forty-ninth year, as my late father returned from Bazhou, he reproached Olondai and others for forming a faction on the road; Olondai was defiant and heedless.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 49, as my late father returned from Bazhou, he reproached Olondai and others for faction on the road; Olondai was defiant and heedless.

sentences.zh: 又從幸熱河，皇考不豫，鄂倫岱日率乾清門侍衛較射遊戲。

translations.literal: Again accompanying him to Rehe, when my late father was unwell, Olondai daily led the Qianqing Gate bodyguards in archery contests and games.
translations.idiomatic: Again at Rehe, when my late father was unwell, Olondai daily led Qianqing Gate bodyguards in archery and games.

sentences.zh: 皇考於行圍時數其罪，命侍衛鞭撻之。

translations.literal: During the hunting encampment my late father repeatedly counted his crimes and ordered bodyguards to flog him.
translations.idiomatic: During the hunting encampment my late father repeatedly counted his crimes and ordered bodyguards to flog him.

sentences.zh: 鄂倫岱頑悍怨望，雖置極典，不足蔽辜。

translations.literal: Olondai was stubborn, fierce, and resentful; even the extreme penalty would not cover his guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Olondai was stubborn, fierce, and resentful; even the extreme penalty would not cover his guilt.

sentences.zh: 朕念為皇祖妣、皇妣之戚，父又陣亡，不忍加誅。

translations.literal: I reflect that he was kin to my imperial grandmother and imperial mother, and his father fell in battle — I could not bear to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that he was kin to my imperial grandmother and mother, and his father died in battle — I could not bear to execute him.

sentences.zh: 令往奉天與阿爾松阿同居。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go to Fengtian and live with Ersong'a.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to Fengtian to live with Ersong'a.

sentences.zh: 」四年，與阿爾松阿並誅，仍諭不籍其家，不沒其妻子。

translations.literal: ' In the fourth year he was executed together with Ersong'a, yet an edict still said his household would not be registered and his wife and children would not be confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: ' In year 4 he was executed with Ersong'a, yet an edict still said his household would not be registered and his wife and children would not be confiscated.

sentences.zh: 子補熙，自廕生授理籓院員外郎，襲國綱拜他喇布勒哈番世職，官至綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: His son Buxi, from yinsheng appointment as an assistant department director in the Court of Colonial Affairs, inherited Guogang's tabun niru hafan hereditary office and rose to General of Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Buxi, by yinsheng made assistant director in the Court of Colonial Affairs, inherited Guogang's tabun niru hafan hereditary office and rose to General of Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 諡溫僖。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Wenxi.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Wenxi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：理密親王既廢，自諸皇子允禟、允䄉輩及諸大臣多謀擁允禩，聖祖終不許。

translations.literal: The commentary says: After Prince Limi was deposed, from the princes Yinqi, Yin'e, and their like to the great ministers, many plotted to install Yinshi, but the Sacred Ancestor never permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: After Prince Limi was deposed, from Princes Yinqi and Yin'e to the great ministers, many plotted to install Yinshi, but the Sacred Ancestor never permitted it.

sentences.zh: 誠以儲位至重，非可以覬覦攘奪而致也。

translations.literal: Truly the heirship is weight beyond measure; it cannot be attained by covetous scheming and seizure.
translations.idiomatic: Truly the heirship weighs beyond measure; it cannot be won by covetous scheming and seizure.

sentences.zh: 佟國維陳奏激切，意若不利於故皇太子，語不及允禩，而意有所在，馬齊遂示意諸大臣。

translations.literal: Tong Guowei's memorial was fiercely worded, as though unfavorable to the former crown prince; his words did not name Yinshi, yet his intent lay elsewhere, and Ma Qi then signaled the great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guowei's memorial was fiercely worded, as though unfavorable to the former crown prince; he did not name Yinshi, yet his intent lay elsewhere, and Ma Qi then signaled the ministers.

sentences.zh: 然二人者，皆非出本心，聖祖諒之，世宗亦諒之，故能恩禮勿替，賞延於後嗣。

translations.literal: Yet neither man acted from his true heart; the Sacred Ancestor understood this, and the Shizong Emperor understood it as well, and so favor and ritual were never withdrawn, and rewards extended to their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Yet neither acted from his true heart; the Sacred Ancestor understood, and Emperor Shizong understood as well, and so favor and ritual were never withdrawn, and rewards extended to their descendants.

sentences.zh: 若阿靈阿父子、揆敘、鄂倫岱、王鴻緒固擁允禩最力者，世宗既譴允禩，諸臣生者被重誅，死者蒙惡名，將安所逃罪？

translations.literal: As for Aringa father and son, Kui Xu, Olondai, and Wang Hongxu — those who most forcefully backed Yinshi — once the Shizong Emperor punished Yinshi, the living ministers suffered heavy execution and the dead bore foul names; where could guilt escape?
translations.idiomatic: As for Aringa father and son, Kui Xu, Olondai, and Wang Hongxu — those who most forcefully backed Yinshi — once Emperor Shizong punished Yinshi, living ministers suffered heavy execution and the dead bore foul names; where could guilt escape?

sentences.zh: 鴻緒又坐與徐乾學等比，被論。

translations.literal: Hongxu was also punished for being classed with Xu Qianxue and others.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxu was also punished for being classed with Xu Qianxue and others.

sentences.zh: 事別見，故不著於此篇。

translations.literal: The affair is treated elsewhere and is therefore not given in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is treated elsewhere and is therefore not given in this chapter.
